title: Geology Field Trip Reminder
transcript: Hi all, a reminder about Saturday's field trip to Pine Creek Canyon. The bus leaves from the science building parking lot at eight sharp, and it won't wait, so please arrive a few minutes early. The trail can get muddy, so wear boots, not sneakers. We'll eat lunch at the canyon, but there's nowhere to buy food out there. Oh, and the forecast says it'll be cold in the morning.

questions.explanation: The speaker reminds students of the departure time, footwear, and food for the trip.
